    Welcome to Galaxy S.

    Time to upgrade your Galaxy. Next-gen Galaxy AI simplifies your daily tasks, while more powerful performance and an extended battery keep you ready for whatever comes next. Enjoy your favourite content on a stunning display and capture high-resolution photos with an advanced camera system. Everything you need, everything you want — all in one incredible device.

    See the highlights

    Three musicians perform on an outdoor stage. Followed by detection boxes around all three performers after the prompt says “Select someone to follow.” The lead singer is selected. The edited video becomes a subject-centered tracking shot that follows the singer on Galaxy S26 FE.

    Center your favorite.

    Every moment, captured in ProVisual detail.

    Super Steady Video. Now steadier.

    Galaxy S26 FE's customised chip is seen with NPU, GPU, and CPU.

    Turbocharged processing speed.

    Get a 6-month trial of Google AI Pro on us.

    DESIGN

    Essential design to frame your everyday.

    Galaxy S26 FE combines a slim, premium design with durable materials and the iconic Galaxy silhouette. Clean lines, balanced proportions, and a refined finish create a sleek look, with strong construction built for everyday reliability. It's a design that balances durability and modern style for those who value both what lasts and what's new.

    Pick your signature shade.

    Galaxy S26 FE comes in three distinctive colours, each thoughtfully selected to complement your everyday life. From the understated confidence of Graphite to the fresh energy of Pistachio and the vibrant character of Blueberry, each shade reflects its own unique vibe. Find your signature colour and let it match your style.

    Pistachio 1

    Graphite 2

    Blueberry 3

    Looks sleek, built tough.

    Galaxy S26 FE pairs a slim, comfortable design with dependable protection for everyday adventures. Encased in Corning® Gorilla® Glass Victus®+ and an aluminum alloy frame, it combines a refined look and feel with a build made to last. An IP68 rating for dust and water resistance gives you added confidence wherever the day takes you.4

    CAMERA

    Check out our camera specs.

    PROVISUAL ENGINE

    Every moment, captured in ProVisual detail.

    Capture clear, high-resolution photos and videos from the moment you shoot to the moment you look back on them. Powered by ProVisual Engine, Galaxy S26 FE enhances image quality and preserves detail across a wide range of shooting situations. Make every shot count with sharp detail, vibrant colour, and true-to-life clarity — with less effort.5

    NIGHTOGRAPHY

    Nights to meet you.

    Some of the best moments happen after sunset. Galaxy S26 FE helps keep photos and videos clear and bright in low-light environments, reducing noise while preserving the details that make nighttime memories worth sharing.6

    ZOOM

    Close. Closer. Whoa.

    A closer look reveals more. 50 MP Zoom technology helps preserve sharp details when you zoom in, so the textures, colours, and intricate elements that caught your eye remain clear in the shot. Sometimes it's the details that leave the biggest impression.7

    SELFIE

    Fit more into every selfie.

    Trying to fit everyone into the selfie? The upgraded 12 MP selfie camera gives you a little more room, so your friends and the view behind you can all fit comfortably in the shot. No one gets left out this time.8

    SUPER STEADY VIDEO

    Super Steady Video. Now steadier.

    Super Steady Video's new Horizontal Lock feature combines expanded optical angles with gyro and acceleration sensors to recognise the direction of gravity and keep your shots level, even if you rotate a full 360°. Whether you're on rocky trails or chasing your fastest finish, get smoother, shake-free videos every time.9

    MY FANCAM

    Center your favourite.

    Get everyone in the shot at an event or a gathering with friends and then put the spotlight on one person later with Galaxy AI. On Galaxy S26 FE's main screen, change wide-angle shots into subject-centred tracking shots cropped to your choice of aspect ratio for easier, more precise edits right from your Gallery.10

    AUDIO ERASER

    Instant audio control during video playback.

    Fine-tune audio and hear more of what you want, even over the noise outside. From livestreams to recorded content on social media, Audio Eraser helps reduce unwanted background noise, so voices and other important sounds come through more clearly.11

    PHOTO ASSIST

    Photo editing, in your own words.

    Photo Assist turns your imagination into reality. Simply describe what you want to see and create visuals from your words and image references — no need for complex editing tools. Whether you're exploring creative concepts, personalising content, or bringing an idea to life, it's an easy way to create in seconds.12

    DOCUMENT SCAN

    Built-in scanning made simple.

    Scan documents and keepsakes without needing additional apps. Document Scan helps reduce distractions such as fingers in the frame and folded corners, while Multi Scan captures multiple items at once. Whether you're saving a concert ticket, collecting travel memories, or sharing an event on social media, it's an easy way to create clean, share-ready scans in just a few taps.13

    ONE UI 9

    Your Galaxy. Your way.

    The new One UI 9 is capable of doing much more — from taking care of tedious tasks to suggesting what I need at the exact moment to adapting to my personal tastes and usage patterns. With AI integrated deeper into the system, you now have the freedom to be more productive and creative. Experience seamless intelligence of your Galaxy that empowers you to see more, create more and understand more.

    KNOX PRIVACY

    Your privacy. Secured.

    We’re committed to protecting your information, while providing transparency about how it’s used and shared.14

    On-device Protection

    Our Personal Data Engine gathers and processes your personal data safely. Then it encrypts that data and saves it onto your device with KEEP and Knox Vault, making it harder for anyone else to gain access.

    Tailored Controls

    Take control over your Galaxy AI. You decide where it gets processed, either on-device or in the cloud.

    Connected Security

    Knox Matrix Trust Chain technology provides security across Galaxy connected devices so you can monitor the security of other devices right from your Galaxy smartphone.

    Circle it, find it.

    Use Circle to Search with Google to find multiple items of a look by simply circling an outfit on your screen, and it will help you find every piece — from tops to footwear and everything in between — all in one search. You can circle it, search it and find the look, all from exactly where you are.15

    Get a 6-month tiral on us

    with Gemini Omni, making it easy to create videos from just an image and a prompt, plus 5 TB of secure cloud storage.16

    PERFORMANCE

    Vibrant display for immersive viewing.

    Enjoy your favourite content on a large 6.7-inch FHD+ display designed for immersive viewing. With a 120 Hz refresh rate, scrolling, streaming and everyday interactions feel smooth and responsive. From stunning natural landscapes and travel videos to photos and everyday entertainment, vivid colours and detailed visuals make every experience more engaging.17

    Charge fast. Play more.

    Built to go the distance, the 4,900 mAh battery keeps you going strong, whether you're tackling a busy day or unwinding with your favourite content. With up to 29 hours of video playback on a single charge, Galaxy S26 FE lets you stay immersed in the content you love.18

    Turbocharged processing speed.

    Built with an advanced processor engineered for speed, responsiveness and efficiency, Galaxy S26 FE helps you stay productive, creative and connected throughout the day. Powerful CPU, GPU and NPU performance help accelerate everything from multitasking to content creation, while optimised processing keeps everyday experiences running smoothly.19

    Stay connected at ultra-high speeds.

    Stay connected at ultra-high speeds with Qualcomm® FastConnect™ 7800 Mobile Connectivity System, so when inspiration strikes, you're ready to act on it. Fast, reliable wireless connectivity keeps you connected to what's happening now. Be there when the next big thing happens.20

    GALAXY ECOSYSTEM

    Better together with Galaxy.

    Sync Galaxy S26 FE with other Samsung devices in the Galaxy for smart, connected living.

    Galaxy Watch9

    Learn more

    Galaxy Buds4

    WHY SWITCH TO GALAXY

    Switch. Easier.

    Imagine where our most powerful devices could take you. Switch to Galaxy and discover a world where all of your technology works together seamlessly, keeping you connected and in control.21

    Quick Share

    Quick Share feature lets you instantly send photos, videos and files to nearby Samsung Galaxy devices without cables or apps. Quick Share now supports AirDrop®, letting you share content seamlessly and securely with friends, family or colleagues — making collaboration and sharing faster and easier than ever on your phone.22

    Learn more

    Make the easy switch

    Use Smart Switch to transfer data from your old phone to Galaxy S26 FE. With an upgraded switching experience, you can easily transfer data from your old iPhone to your new Galaxy wirelessly by simply scanning a QR code. It quickly and securely moves your contacts, photos, messages and apps from any device in just minutes. This seamless process helps you start enjoying Galaxy S26 FE's powerful features, vibrant display and smooth performance without missing a beat.23

    Learn more

    Discover what benefits you can get.

    OS Upgrade

    Galaxy S26 FE supports up to 7x of OS upgrades and up to 7 years of security updates to keep it running as good as new.24

    Trade-In

    Receive an instant discount when you trade in your old device.

    Frequently Asked Questions

    Galaxy S26 FE stands out from other smartphones with its advanced camera system, Galaxy AI features, expansive display and long-lasting battery life. • Capture high-quality photos and videos with a versatile camera system and image processing that enhances detail, colour, and clarity. • Use Galaxy AI to edit photos or streamline everyday tasks. • Enjoy smooth scrolling and vibrant visuals on a large 6.7-inch FHD+ display. • Stay powered throughout the day with a 4,900 mAh battery and fast charging support.26

    Yes. Galaxy S26 FE guarantees 7 major Android OS upgrades and up to 7 years of security patches, launching with One UI 9 based on Android 17. In addition to keeping your device secure and up to date, ongoing software updates will bring improvements to existing Galaxy AI features and introduce new experiences for years to come.27

    Start by using Smart Switch during initial setup to transfer important data from your old phone. This gives you a smooth transition so you can start using your Galaxy S26 FE just like your previous device with everything already in place. • Move contacts, photos, apps and more with Smart Switch. • Explore the Camera app's ProVisual Engine settings to optimise photo and video capture. • Enable Galaxy AI features in Settings to unlock photo editing, audio tools, and live translation. • Sign in with your Samsung Account to sync Galaxy AI preferences and backups across devices.28

    Galaxy S26 FE is available in three stunning colors: Pistachio, Graphite, and Blueberry.25

    Galaxy S26 FE works best with Magnet Case if you want convenience and everyday protection. • The case has a built-in magnetic ring that helps your phone align perfectly with compatible wireless chargers and magnetic accessories. • This makes charging easier and more reliable and allows you to attach accessories securely. • It also offers protection against bumps and scratches, combining charging convenience and protection in one simple solution.30

    Galaxy S26 FE is fortified with materials that strengthen the device for long-lasting durability. • The aluminum alloy frame provides enhanced protection for the device’s internal components and exterior edges without adding excessive bulk. • Engineered using an ion-strengthened glass formula, Corning® Gorilla® Glass Victus®+ has been applied to the front and back of the devices for impact protection without compromising visual clarity. • The IP68 rating provides enough water and dust resistance to protect your device against accidental spills and everyday mishaps.34

    Galaxy S26 FE runs on the Exynos 2500 processor, which is designed to deliver superior CPU, GPU, NPU and AI performance. • This processor is designed to enhance multitasking, camera performance and overall energy efficiency. • A boost to the advanced NPU provides faster and smarter AI performance.31

    Galaxy S26 FE delivers noticeably longer usage time than previous mid-range Galaxy models, making it easy to get through a full day of heavy use on a single charge. • The 4,900 mAh battery keeps you powered throughout the day for everyday activities. • With up to 29 hours of video playback on a single charge, Galaxy S26 FE lets you stay immersed in the content you love uninterrupted. • When you do need to top up, fast 45 W wired and 15 W wireless charging quickly gets you back to a high battery level with less waiting.32

    Galaxy S26 FE is available in 128 GB, 256 GB, and 512 GB storage options, giving you the flexibility to choose the capacity you need. • 128 GB is well suited for everyday activities such as messaging, streaming, social media, and storing a typical collection of photos and videos. • 256 GB and 512 GB provides additional space for content creators, avid photographers, and users who prefer to keep more apps, media and files stored.33

    Galaxy S26 FE can zoom up to 30x digitally with 3x Optical Zoom. • Up to 3x Optical Zoom uses the dedicated telephoto lens. This is the maximum possible zoom without loss of quality. • Digital Zoom up to 30x lets you frame distant subjects and capture details beyond the optical range.35

    Yes. Galaxy S26 FE features Super Steady with Horizontal Lock, an advanced video stabilisation mode designed to help reduce camera shake during active filming. • Horizontal Lock works by keeping your phone's horizon line steady — so even when your hand tilts side to side or the phone rotates while you're moving, the scene in your video stays level and balanced — so your handheld moments come out smoother and more watchable. • Just open the Camera app, switch to Video and turn on Super Steady with Horizontal Lock for your active scenes.36

    Galaxy S26 FE combines high-resolution photography, optical zoom capabilities and advanced image processing in one camera system. • 50 MP Wide with OIS for sharp and stable shots. • 12 MP Ultra Wide for broader landscapes and group shots. • The 8 MP Tele camera with 3x optical zoom for capturing distant subjects. • The 12 MP front camera for selfies and video calls. • ProVisual Engine and Nightography for enhanced image quality in a variety of lighting conditions.41

    Galaxy S26 FE comes with a range of Galaxy AI features to help you create, edit, search and get more done. Some AI tools have also been refined to deliver even better results. • Audio Eraser helps reduce unwanted background noise in videos, making voices and important sounds easier to hear. • My FanCam automatically adjusts framing to keep the focus on key people and moments.37

    As of July 2026, Galaxy AI's Photo Assist and Creative Studio support 41 languages. Full list of languages is below. • Photo Assist & Creative Studio supported languages: Korean, Arabic, Bengali, Bulgarian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Latvian, Lithuanian, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Swahili, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Filipino and Gujarati.

    Samsung Galaxy S26 FE’s AI is built with privacy in mind, from how data is processed to how it’s stored and managed. • Galaxy AI processes data on your device through the Personal Data Engine and is then encrypted and saved on your device with KEEP and Knox Vault. • With clear, AI-secure privacy settings in Controls, you have the power to choose which AI features can access personal data. • Connected security powered by Knox Matrix Trust Chain technology protects your entire ecosystem of Samsung devices, which you can control from your Galaxy smartphone.38

    Switching to Galaxy S26 FE is simple in just a few easy steps, whether you're coming from an Android or iOS device. • Use Smart Switch to transfer contacts, photos, videos, messages, apps and other important data automatically from your previous phone. • Follow simple on-screen instructions to sign in, connect to your network and personalise your device, so your new phone feels familiar from the start.29

    You can quickly share photos, videos, documents and other files — of various numbers and sizes. If your friends are using iOS devices, you can still share with them via nearby devices or a QR code. • After installing the latest software update to your Galaxy S26 FE, you will be able to share with Apple devices that support AirDrop®. • To receive files from an Apple device, ensure your Galaxy S26 FE is on the Quick Share receiving screen or change the receiving settings to "Everyone", then ask the sender to share files via AirDrop®.39

    For people switching from another smartphone brand, Galaxy S26 FE offers a combination of a large immersive display, advanced camera capabilities and Galaxy AI features that help make everyday experiences more convenient and enjoyable. • Smart Switch makes it easy to move important data from a previous device. • 7x of Android OS upgrades and upto 7 years of security updates help keep the experience fresh with new features and ongoing improvements over time.40

    Galaxy S26 FE is a compelling choice if you're looking for a Galaxy phone that blends intelligent AI with creative photo editing. • Use Galaxy AI features such as Photo Assist to enhance photos, remove distractions, and refine your content. • Turn ideas into unique visual content with Creative Studio, turning text prompts and sketches into personalised sticker sets to use and share.42

    Yes. If you're coming from Galaxy S21 FE, Galaxy S26 FE brings several camera enhancements that makes it easier to capture high-quality photos and videos with great detail and clarity. • The main camera lens jumps from 12 MP on Galaxy S21 FE to a 50 MP sensor on Galaxy S26 FE, letting you crop or zoom into a shot while retaining impressive image quality. • Powered by ProVisual Engine, Galaxy S26 FE delivers sharper details and vibrant colours. • Galaxy AI-powered editing tools offer intuitive ways to refine and personalise your content.43

    For many Galaxy S21 FE and Galaxy S22 users, Galaxy S26 FE can feel like a noticeable upgrade. You'll get a larger display, improved camera capabilities, a longer-lasting battery life and faster overall performance. With continued software updates and evolving Galaxy AI experiences, Galaxy S26 FE helps you with everything from creativity to everyday productivity.44

    Galaxy S26 FE is a great pick for anyone who wants the best features of Galaxy S series at a more accessible price. • It's perfect for those who enjoy taking high-quality photos and videos and want advanced camera capabilities inspired by Galaxy S series, without compromising on affordability. • If you're curious about Galaxy AI, it offers a range of smart features that can help make everyday tasks easier and more creative.

Po spustení krásny veľký, prehľadný displej. Rýchle reakcie. Dizajn OK. Chladný rám na dotyk, ale po vložení do ochranného puzdra sa toto eliminuje a transparentné nechá dizajn vyniknúť. AI priamo v telefóne. Do budúcnosti dlhoročná podpora (7 rokov). Na veľkosť v ruke sa rýchlo zvykne. Celkovo s mobilom veľká spokojnosť.

    Storage : 128 GB | Colour : Pistachio
    Product Ratings : 5
    Das Samsung Galaxy S26 FE wurde mir von Samsung für zwei Wochen zur Verfügung gestellt. In dieser Zeit durfte ich das neue Smartphone in meinem Alltag auf Herz und Nieren testen. Als bisheriger Nutzer eines Galaxy S24 Plus war ich besonders auf die Unterschiede zu meinem Vorgängergerät gespannt. Die Verarbeitung ist Samsung sehr gut gelungen. Der Aluminiumrahmen und die Glasrückseite wirken auf mich hochwertiger, als es bei vorherigen FE Modellen war. Mir gefällt der Farbton Pistachio sehr gut, er ist edel und unaufdringlich. Das Smartphone liegt trotz des recht großen Displays angenehm in meiner Hand. Selbst längere Videositzungen sind möglich, ohne dass das Gewicht störend wird. Optisch gefällt es mir sogar besser als mein früheres Galaxy S24 Plus, da die Außenkamera schöner in das Design integriert wurde. Das Display bietet eine angepasste Bildwiederholrate von bis zu 120 Hz. Dies ermöglicht ein sauberes, ruckelfreies Scrollen. Kleine Abstriche gegenüber der regulären S-Klasse: Die Auflösung des Displays ist auf 1080p begrenzt. Zudem ist der schwarze Displayrand doch recht breit ausgefallen. Der Arbeitsspeicher beträgt nur 8 GB. Im Alltag fällt das jedoch kaum negativ auf und reicht für Multitasking völlig aus. Alle Apps öffnen schnell und ohne Verzögerung. Mit 512 GB Speicherplatz bleibt reichlich Reserve für Fotos und 4K-Videos. Der Akku hält bei intensiver Nutzung problemlos den gesamten Tag durch. Ich musste mir unterwegs keine Gedanken um Zwischenladungen machen. Mit der 45W-Schnelllade-Funktion ist das Gerät in knapp über einer Stunde wieder voll. Das spart im Alltag viel Zeit. Die Kamera liefert gute und verlässliche Ergebnisse, auch bei schlechteren Lichtverhältnissen. Richtig gut finde ich die Superstabil-Funktion bei Videos. Diese gleicht etwaige Verwacklungen auch bei schneller Bewegung zuverlässig aus. Die Kamera reicht natürlich nicht an ein S26 Ultra heran. Hinter meinem S24 Plus muss sie sich aber keinesfalls verstecken. Für mich ist das Samsung Galaxy S26 FE ein gelungenes Gesamtpaket. Die zwei Wochen mit dem Gerät haben mir echt Spaß gemacht. Wer ein solides Gerät zum fairen Preis sucht, kann hier bedenkenlos zugreifen. Von mir gibt es eine klare Kaufempfehlung.

    Samsung Galaxy S26 FE Review: Das Flaggschiff-Erlebnis zum fairen PrKombination aus Leistung, Display und Zukunftsfähigkeit ist, bekommt hier ein absolut gelungenes Gesamtpaket geliefert. eis ​Das Samsung Galaxy S26 FE (Fan Edition) beweist eindrucksvoll, wie viel High-End-Technik in ein preislich attraktives Paket passt. Wer auf der Suche nach einer erstklassigen ​1. Display & Design: Flaggschiff-Feeling im Alltag ​Schon beim ersten Anschalten überzeugt das 6,7 Zoll große Dynamic AMOLED-Display auf ganzer Linie. Linie. • ​Bildwiederholrate: Butterweiche 120 Hz sorgen dafür, dass Animationen, Games und Scrollen extrem flüssig wirken. • ​Helligkeit & Farben: Kräftige Farben, tiefes Schwarz und eine hervorragende Spitzenhelligkeit garantieren beste Lesbarkeit – selbst bei starker Sonneneinstrahlung. • ​Verarbeitung: Das edle Gehäuse ist gewohnt stark geschützt (IP68-Zertifizierung gegen Wasser und Staub) und liegt trotz des großen Screens hervorragend in der Hand. ​2. Performance & Hardware: Schnelligkeit für alle Aufgaben ​Unter der Haube verrichtet der Exynos 2500 modernste Arbeit. • ​Reaktionsschnell: Egal ob anspruchsvolles Multitasking, Bildbearbeitung oder grafikintensive Spiele – die Performance ist durchweg flüssig und zuverlässig. • ​Alltagstauglich: Apps starten ohne spürbare Verzögerungen, und das System fühlt sich durchgehend flott an. ​3. Kamera: Starkes Setup bei Tag und Nacht ​Die vielseitige Triple-Kamera macht Fotos im Alltag zu einem echten Genuss: • ​50-MP-Hauptkamera: Liefert knackscharfe Bilder mit hoher Detailtreue, hervorragendem Dynamikumfang und natürlichen Farben. • ​Optimierter Nachtmodus: Auch bei schlechtem Licht holt das S26 FE im Vergleich zum Vorgänger erstaunlich viel Schärfe und Details aus den Aufnahmen heraus – ganz ohne störendes Bildrauschen. • ​Echtes Teleobjektiv: Dank des optischen 3-fach-Zooms lassen sich entfernte Motive ohne Qualitätsverlust nah heranholen. ​4. Akku & Software: Ein Begleiter für die Zukunft • ​Akkulaufzeit: Der 4.900-mAh-Akku hält bei normaler bis intensiver Nutzung problemlos den ganzen Tag durch. Dank der 45-Watt-Schnellladefunktion ist das Smartphone im Notfall auch ruckzuck wieder einsatzbereit. • ​Update-Garantie: Ein riesiger Pluspunkt ist der langjährige Software-Support. Samsung liefert Updates bis 2033, wodurch das Smartphone extrem zukunftssicher ist. • ​Galaxy AI: Auch sämtliche modernen KI-Funktionen für Fotobearbeitung, Live-Übersetzungen und Produktivität sind nahtlos in die One UI integriert. ​Fazit ​Das Samsung Galaxy S26 FE erfüllt die Erwartungen an eine Fan Edition vollkommen. Es kombiniert die wichtigsten Premium-Features der S-Klasse – ein fantastisches Display, eine starke Dreifach-Kamera, top Performance und extrem langen Update-Support – in einem modernen Design. Ein absolut empfehlenswertes Smartphone für alle, die High-End-Qualität suchen!  Momentan nutze ich noch das S23 Ultra. Wenn ich mich für ein Günstiges Gerät entscheiden müsste ohne viel Abstriche machen zu müssen, wäre das S26 FE eine Kaufentscheidung. Es hat für mir in keinem Moment das Gefühl gegeben das ich was vermissen würde bzw was nicht richtig läuft. Auch der Akku in Kombination mit dem Exynos 2500 fand ich ein super Team.

    [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I've had my S26 fe for a few weeks now. It looks good and was really easy to set up. I had an S24 previously and chose to upgrade to the fe version due to it's affordability. All the features I've looked at so far are really good, except for the camera - the S24 took amazing night photos of the northern lights, but this phone doesn't have the clarity of my old phone, which is a little disappointing. Also the motion photos don't seem to work. The sound quality seems to have been sacrificed in order to make this phone cheaper, but it'll just take time to get used to the extra echo on songs (I have played with the equalizer to no avail). All in all it's a good phone with good battery life, and although the display isn't quite as nice as the non fe version, the performance has so far proved to be just as good.
